purpose: Self-authored bilingual debugging fixtures; not quotations from published poems. Human aesthetic evaluation pending.

samples.text: The rain has left the lake. Under the grey sky, the water holds the silence of the shore.
samples.watch_for: Rain has ended; avoid treating every weather keyword as present.

samples.text: I walk alone through the winter trees. The snow keeps the shape of every silence.
samples.watch_for: Natural winter textures; avoid invented people unless useful.

samples.text: Warm sunlight rests on the grass. For a moment, the world asks for nothing.
samples.watch_for: Warm highlights must survive the cool default.

samples.text: The sea returns what I cannot name. Each wave folds a little distance into the shore.
samples.watch_for: Metaphor need not become literal objects.

samples.text: An empty street receives the evening. One window still remembers the light.
Between yesterday and tomorrow, a small silence opens its hands.
samples.watch_for: Acknowledge creative supplementation; no literal giant hands.

samples.text: 雨已经离开湖面。灰色天空下，水留住了岸边的沉默。
我独自走过冬日的树林，雪替每一种沉默留下形状。
温暖的阳光停在草地上。那一刻，世界不再向我索取什么。
samples.watch_for: 不能强行变成蓝色阴郁画面。

samples.text: 海把我无法命名的事物送回岸边，每一道浪都折叠了一点远方。
空街迎接黄昏，仍有一扇窗记得白天的光。
在昨天与明天之间，一小片沉默张开了双手。
samples.watch_for: 克制转译；补充内容应明确记录。
